summary.en: While at a camping trip, The Detective Boys are surprisingly greeted by Masumi Sera. While the Professor sets up camp and Conan chats with Masumi, Ayumi, Genta, Haibara, and Mitsuhiko venture into the woods and come across a person burying a body. The woman was being buried by her killer when Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, Genta, and Haibara stumbled upon the cover-up. The culprit gives chase. While the children run, Haibara alerts the police, and then they hide in a dark cabin, only to figure out it is where the culprit was earlier. To prevent them from talking, the culprit locks them in and sets the cabin blaze. The culprit decides to silence the Detective Boys by locking them inside the cabin then set it on fire. Inspector Yamamura arrives to the scene of the body, and later has three suspects. The only clue is a dying message of her fingers being in an odd form behind her back.
summary.zhHans: 灰原哀的秘密再次成为调查焦点，组织威胁与安室透相关情报在列车篇章前后继续发酵。
